`ui/src/bindings.ts` is generated by `crates/app/tests/bindings.rs` from `crates/app/src/lib.rs::specta_builder` and byte-checked there; a command's shape or its refusal type is a `crates/app` finding, not a UI one, and the file is never edited by hand. `ui/src/components/ui/**` is vendored shadcn/ui; report nothing there. `@tauri-apps` is imported there and nowhere else, and a raw color literal under `ui/src/` fails a `tools/guard` lane; leave both to the guard. A `Result`-returning command answers a refusal and a transport failure alike as `{ status: "error" }`, read through `ui/src/lib/refusal.ts`; a component reading the error's fields is a finding. Domain logic and types live in Rust; a UI component that decides a domain question is a finding.
